arxiv-1812-09140.title: Gradient-based deterministic inversion of geophysical data with Generative Adversarial Networks: is it feasible?
arxiv-1812-09140.creator: Eric Laloy, Niklas Linde, Cyprien Ruffino, Romain Hérault, Gilles Gasso, and Diederik Jacques
arxiv-1812-09140.description: A 2018 arXiv research paper by Eric Laloy, Niklas Linde, Cyprien Ruffino, Romain Hérault, Gilles Gasso, and Diederik Jacques. Global probabilistic inversion within the latent space learned by a Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) has been recently demonstrated. Compared to inversion on the original model space, using the latent space of a trained GAN can offer the following benefits: (1) the generated model proposals are geostatistically consistent with the prescribed prior training image (TI), and (2) the parameter space is reduced by orders of magnitude compared to the original model space.

arxiv-2011-12731.title: Lower Gaussian heat kernel bounds for the Random Conductance Model in a degenerate ergodic environment
arxiv-2011-12731.creator: Sebastian Andres, Noah Halberstam
arxiv-2011-12731.description: Abstract . We study the random conductance model on ℤ d \Z^{d} with ergodic, unbounded conductances. We prove a Gaussian lower bound on the heat kernel given a polynomial moment condition and some additional assumptions on the correlations of the conductances. The proof is based on the well-established chaining technique. We also obtain bounds on the Green’s function.

arxiv-2102-04096.description: Abstract Dc and ac – \textendash magnetic susceptibility ( χ \chi ), specific heat ( C P C_{\mathrm{P}} ), electrical resistivity ( ρ \rho ) and magnetoresistance measurements performed on the new polycrystalline compound Gd 2 ​ AgSi 3 \mathrm{Gd_{2}AgSi_{3}} , crystallizing in the α \alpha – \textendash ThSi 2 \mathrm{ThSi_{2}} tetragonal structure, are reported.

arxiv-2107-05300.title: Plasmonic response of a nanorod in the vicinity of a metallic surface: local approach with analytical solution
arxiv-2107-05300.creator: I. M. Vasilevskiy, N. M. R. Peres
arxiv-2107-05300.description: Abstract In this paper we present an analytical solution for the eigenmodes and corresponding electric fields of a composite system made of a nanorod in the vicinity of a plasmonic semi-infinite metallic system. To be specific, we choose Silver as the material for both the nanorod and the semi-infinite metal.

arxiv-2309-15486.title: Transferability of Representations Learned using Supervised Contrastive Learning Trained on a Multi-Domain Dataset
arxiv-2309-15486.creator: Alvin De Jun Tan, Clement Tan, Chai Kiat Yeo
arxiv-2309-15486.description: Abstract Contrastive learning has shown to learn better quality representations than models trained using cross-entropy loss. They also transfer better to downstream datasets from different domains. However, little work has been done to explore the transferability of representations learned using contrastive learning when trained on a multi-domain dataset.

arxiv-2402-14096.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Yifan Zhang, Jiliang Li, Zachary Karas, Aakash Bansal, Toby Jia-Jun Li, Collin McMillan, Kevin Leach, Yu Huang. Neural code summarization leverages deep learning models to automatically generate brief natural language summaries of code snippets. The development of Transformer models has led to extensive use of attention during model design.

arxiv-2405-04689.title: Signature of T c {}_{\textrm{c}} above 111 K in Li-doped (Bi,Pb)-2223 superconductors: synergistic nature of hole concentration, coherence length and Josephson interlayer coupling
arxiv-2405-04689.creator: N. K. Man, Huu T. Do
arxiv-2405-04689.description: Abstract Understanding the bottleneck to drive higher critical transition temperature T c T_{\textrm{c}} plays a pivotal role in the underlying study of superconductors. We systematically investigate the effect of Li + substitution for Cu 2+ cations on the T c T_{\textrm{c}} , hole concentration, coherence length and interlayer coupling, and microstructure in Li-doped Bi 1.6 Pb 0.

arxiv-2503-01595.title: STAR: Stability-Inducing Weight Perturbation for Continual Learning
arxiv-2503-01595.creator: Masih Eskandar, Tooba Imtiaz, Davin Hill, Zifeng Wang, Jennifer Dy
arxiv-2503-01595.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Masih Eskandar, Tooba Imtiaz, Davin Hill, Zifeng Wang, Jennifer Dy. Humans can naturally learn new and varying tasks in a sequential manner. Continual learning is a class of learning algorithms that updates its learned model as it sees new data (on potentially new tasks) in a sequence. A key challenge in continual learning is that as the model is updated to learn new tasks, it becomes susceptible to catastrophic forgetting , where knowledge of previously learned tasks is lost.

arxiv-2504-04865.title: Imagining the Far East: Exploring Perceived Biases in AI-Generated Images of East Asian Women
arxiv-2504-04865.creator: Xingyu Lan, Jiaxi An, Yisu Guo, Chiyou Tong, Xintong Cai, Jun Zhang
arxiv-2504-04865.description: Abstract . Image-generating AI, which allows users to create images from text, is increasingly used to produce visual content. Despite its advancements, cultural biases in AI-generated images have raised significant concerns. While much research has focused on issues within Western contexts, our study examines the perceived biases regarding the portrayal of East Asian women.

arxiv-2505-18973.title: Hierarchical Mamba Meets Hyperbolic Geometry: A New Paradigm for Structured Language Embeddings
arxiv-2505-18973.creator: Sarang Patil sp3463@njit.edu, Ashish Parmanand Pandey ap2934@njit.edu, Ioannis Koutis ikoutis@njit.edu, Mengjia Xu mx6@njit.edu
arxiv-2505-18973.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Sarang Patil sp3463@njit.edu, Ashish Parmanand Pandey ap2934@njit.edu, Ioannis Koutis ikoutis@njit.edu, Mengjia Xu mx6@njit.edu. Selective state-space models excel at long-sequence modeling, but their capacity for language representation – in complex hierarchical reasoning – remains underexplored. Most large language models rely on flat Euclidean embeddings, limiting their ability to capture latent hierarchies. To address this, we propose Hierarchical Mamba (HiM) , integrating efficient Mamba2 with hyperbolic geometry to learn hierarchy-aware language embeddings for deeper linguistic understanding.

arxiv-2507-16069.title: Interpreting CFD Surrogates through Sparse Autoencoders
arxiv-2507-16069.creator: Yeping Hu, Shusen Liu
arxiv-2507-16069.description: Abstract Learning‑based surrogate models have become a practical alternative to high‑fidelity CFD solvers, but their latent representations remain opaque and hinder adoption in safety‑critical or regulation‑bound settings. This work introduces a post-hoc interpretability framework for graph-based surrogate models used in computational fluid dynamics (CFD) by leveraging sparse autoencoders (SAEs).

arxiv-2509-15596.title: EyePCR: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Fine-Grained Perception, Knowledge Comprehension and Clinical Reasoning in Ophthalmic Surgery
arxiv-2509-15596.creator: Gui Wang †, Yang Wennuo †, Xusen Ma, Zehao Zhong, Zhuoru Wu, Ende Wu, Rong Qu, Wooi Ping Cheah, Jianfeng Ren *, Linlin Shen *
arxiv-2509-15596.description: Abstract MLLMs (Multimodal Large Language Models) have showcased remarkable capabilities, but their performance in high-stakes, domain-specific scenarios like surgical settings, remains largely under-explored. To address this gap, we develop EyePCR , a large-scale benchmark for ophthalmic surgery analysis, grounded in structured clinical knowledge to evaluate cognition across Perception , Comprehension and Reasoning .

arxiv-2511-01635.title: Spectral curvature and breaks from Fermi acceleration at oblique shocks 2026 Spectral curvature and breaks from Fermi acceleration at oblique shocks – 6
arxiv-2511-01635.creator: Asma Shirin T, Brian Reville, Nils W. Schween, Florian Schulze, John G. Kirk
arxiv-2511-01635.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Asma Shirin T, Brian Reville, Nils W. Schween, Florian Schulze, John G. Kirk. A major attraction of diffusive shock acceleration is the prediction of power-law spectra for energetic particle distributions. However, this property is not fundamental to the theory. We demonstrate that for planar shocks with an oblique magnetic field the generation of power-law spectra critically requires the particles’ scattering rate to be both directly proportional to their gyro radius ( Bohm scaling ) and spatially uniform.

pmc-10737571.creator: Laurel Mertz, Jennifer Smith, Nicole Lehpamer, Ajla Basic, Catherine O’Brien

pmc-11574991.title: It is time to address fear of cancer recurrence in family caregivers: protocol for the feasibility and acceptability of a randomized pilot study of the online version of the Family Caregiver–Fear Of Recurrence Therapy (FC-FORT)

pmc-11574991.description: BackgroundFear of cancer recurrence (FCR) is common, persistent, and is associated with lower quality of life, impaired functioning, and psychological distress in cancer patients. Studies suggest that family caregivers of cancer patients experience equal or greater levels of FCR than patients themselves.

pmc-13477050.creator: Taiki Takasugi, Tohru Mawatari
pmc-13477050.description: ObjectivesRobot-assisted thoracoscopic surgery has been increasingly adopted for lung resection, and opportunities for novice surgeons to perform this procedure are expanding. pmc-13585034.title: Reduced incidence of ventilator-associated pneumonia (VAP) at a tertiary care center due to enhanced compliance with evidence-based bundle care practices through structured training programs for ICU healthcare workers: a pilot study
